an5.31:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.31:1.2: atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho sumanā rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.31:2.1: idhassu bhante bhagavato dve sāvakā samasaddhā samasīlā samapaññā,
an5.31:2.3: te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyuṃ,
an5.31:2.4: devabhūtānampana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇanti?
an5.31:3.2: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ devabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:3.3: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena ādhipateyyena.
an5.31:3.4: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ devabhūto samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an5.31:4.1: sace pana te bhante tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchanti, manussabhūtānaṃ pana tesaṃ bhante siyā viseso, siyā nānākaraṇanti?
an5.31:4.3: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:4.4: mānusakena āyunā, mānusakena vaṇṇena, mānusakena sukhena, mānusakena yasena, mānusakena ādhipateyyena.
an5.31:4.5: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an5.31:5.1: sace pana te bhante ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, pabbajitānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇanti?
an5.31:5.3: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ pabbajito samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:5.4: yācito’va bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito. yācitova bahulaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati, appaṃ ayācito. yācito’va bahulaṃ senāsanaṃ paribhuñjati, appaṃ ayācito. yācito’va bahulaṃ gilāna paccaya bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjati, appaṃ ayācito:
an5.31:5.5: yehi kho pana sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṃ viharati, tyāssa manāpeneva bahulaṃ kāyakammena samudācaranti, appaṃ amanāpena, manāpeneva bahulaṃ vacīkammena samudācaranti, appaṃ amanāpena, manāpeneva bahulaṃ manokammena samudācaranti, appaṃ amanāpena. manāpaṃ yeva upahāraṃ upaharanti, appaṃ amanāpaṃ.
an5.31:5.6: yo so sumane dāyako, so amuṃ adāyakaṃ pabbajito samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti.
an5.31:6.1: sace pana te bhante ubho arahattaṃ pāpuṇanti, arahattappattānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇanti?
an5.31:6.2: ettha kho panesāhaṃ sumane na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttinti.
an5.31:7.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhante alameva dānāni dātuṃ, alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ,
an5.31:7.3: yatra hi nāma devabhūtassapi upakārāni puññāni, manussabhūtassapi upakārāni puññāni, pabbajitassapi upakārāni puññānīti. eva metaṃ sumane,
an5.31:7.5: alaṃ hi sumane dānāni dātuṃ, alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ.
an5.31:7.6: devabhūtassapi upakārāni puññāni. manussabhūtassapi upakārāni puññāni, pabbajitassapi upakārāni puññānīti.
an5.31:8.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
